svg.title: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram: new review
svg.desc:
PRISMA 2020 flow diagram: new review
Study identification and selection for fixture-new-db-registers, using databases and registers only.
Stages: 1. Records identified from: Databases (n = 120) Registers (n = 30) Total (n = 150) 2. Records removed before screening: Duplicate records (n = 20) Marked ineligible by automation (n = 5) Other reasons (n = 5) Total removed (n = 30) 3. Records screened (n = 120) 4. Records excluded (n = 70) 5. Reports sought for retrieval (n = 50) 6. Reports not retrieved (n = 5) 7. Reports assessed for eligibility (n = 45) 8. Reports excluded (n = 25): Wrong population (n = 10) Wrong intervention (n = 8) Wrong study design (n = 7) 9. Studies included in review (n = 16) Reports of included studies (n = 20)
Flow relationships: 1. Records identified from: Databases (n = 120) Registers (n = 30) Total (n = 150) → Records removed before screening: Duplicate records (n = 20) Marked ineligible by automation (n = 5) Other reasons (n = 5) Total removed (n = 30) (exclusion) 2. Records identified from: Databases (n = 120) Registers (n = 30) Total (n = 150) → Records screened (n = 120) (progression) 3. Records screened (n = 120) → Records excluded (n = 70) (exclusion) 4. Records screened (n = 120) → Reports sought for retrieval (n = 50) (progression) 5. Reports sought for retrieval (n = 50) → Reports not retrieved (n = 5) (exclusion) 6. Reports sought for retrieval (n = 50) → Reports assessed for eligibility (n = 45) (progression) 7. Reports assessed for eligibility (n = 45) → Reports excluded (n = 25): Wrong population (n = 10) Wrong intervention (n = 8) Wrong study design (n = 7) (exclusion) 8. Reports assessed for eligibility (n = 45) → Studies included in review (n = 16) Reports of included studies (n = 20) (merge)
